page_note: 该页为IEA《Energy Technology Perspectives 2023》第57页，正文两段加一幅编号图1.11，图内含三个异质面板：两个堆叠柱面板（Average yearly CAPEX、Cumulative CAPEX）和一个用双箭头表示投资决策可用时间的时间轴面板。

heading.title: Global investment in selected clean energy supply chains needed to bring online enough capacity in 2030 in the NZE Scenario, by supply chain step

panel_names: Time available for final investment decision
figures.value_axis_ticks: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200 (Average yearly CAPEX); 0, 500, 1 000, 1 500 (Cumulative CAPEX); x ticks 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030 (Time available for final investment decision)
figures.source_line: Sources: IEA analysis based on company announcement; Bartholomeusz (2022); S&P Capital (2022).

two stacked-bar panels beside 'Time available for final investment decision' drawn as double-headed arrows

'Billion USD' set vertically along the left axis of the first two panels

new_components.name: arrow_range_timeline_panel
new_components.evidence: third panel shows four double-headed arrows spanning 2023 to about 2025-2028 on a year axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数不是柱高而是箭头两端的年份区间，行键必须给出起止年而非单一数值。

new_components.name: category_identified_by_legend_colour_only
new_components.evidence: the four arrows carry no labels; only colour matches the legend series names
new_components.why_it_matters: 第三面板每条箭头无文字标签，表格行只能靠图例颜色名称对应，解析器易漏掉该面板全部行。

new_components.name: key_message_line_below_figure
new_components.evidence: bold blue line 'Most of the supply chain investments needed to meet NZE Scenario targets in 2030...' under sources
new_components.why_it_matters: 图的核心结论（七倍、2023-2025）写在图外正文行里，取值时的语境需从该行而非表格获得。

new_components.name: licence_line_below_figure
new_components.evidence: 'IEA. CC BY 4.0.' printed right-aligned between legend and the Notes block
new_components.why_it_matters: 该行夹在图例与注释之间，容易被当作来源行，影响注释/来源的切分与定位。

new_components.name: space_grouped_thousands_ticks
new_components.evidence: middle panel ticks printed '1 000' and '1 500' with a space separator
new_components.why_it_matters: 千位用空格分隔，数值检索时'1 000'与'1000'不匹配，取值字符串需归一化。

difficulty_notes: 取值精度是最大瓶颈。中间面板轴刻度为0、500、1 000、1 500，四段共约200像素高，1个单位约0.4像素；要把150这一段读到±5%（即±7.5 Billion USD）只有约3像素余量，而三段150/150/250彼此仅相差约100单位（约40像素），颜色带又极窄，几乎无法在容差内区分。左面板刻度间隔50，读35与40（相差5，约6像素）同样紧张。标签层面虽然需要面板名+期间+图例名三个键（且150在三处重复），但这些标签都是页面上逐字可得的；第三面板箭头无数值可读，只能给区间。
